title: Set Rule makes one entry on the tier and one on each matrix
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix B.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Check matrix A.
  4. Check matrix B.
  5. Type 10 in the bulk bar's value.
  6. Click Set Rule.
  7. Click Set Rule in the dialog.
  8. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  9. Click Audit Log.
  10. Click Close.
  11. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  12. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  13. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  14. Click Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • Matrix A is checked.

Step 4:

  • Matrix B is checked.

Step 5:

  • The value reads 10.

Step 6:

  • The Set Rule question opens.

Step 7:

  • Matrices A and B read 10% off.

Step 8:

  • The menu lists Audit Log.

Step 9:

  • The newest entry is one "Tier Rule Set" entry reading "Rule set in 2 matrices".
  • No second entry was added for the same Set Rule.

Step 10:

  • The dialog closes.

Step 11:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 12:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 13:

  • The menu lists Audit Log.

Step 14:

  • Matrix A's log has one "Tier Rule Set" entry naming tier A.
